ms.promise:
Development of a Framework for Modelling Data Curation:
・The framework will be the enablement of pulling on-chain dara around tokens to feed into systems models that are developed in Python. 
・Basic transaction types to be included in the framework consist of basic token swaps to highlight how users are utilizing the token.
・A stretch goal will be to enable the framework to understand p2p transactions as well as smart contract interactions, such as staking.
